runtime.note: TTL is non-renewable by design — preserves the isolation guarantee of ephemeral dispatch. Do not propose making it renewable; the fix is structural in pre-dispatch planning.

ceiling.calibration_basis: Initial empirical estimate ~15-18 items per dispatch at TTL 600s for typical codegen workloads. Pending replacement with measured telemetry from viv-aidlc-orchestrator#12.

backend-implementer.rationale: Items typically share contracts; one broken item invalidates downstream items.

frontend-implementer.rationale: Components are often independent; partial completion preserves value.

migration-agent.rationale: Schema statements may have ordering dependencies; rollback preserves invariants.

codegen-stubs.rationale: Stubs are independent; partial scaffolding has value.

test-generator.rationale: Tests are independent; missing tests are visible to humans.

external-api-caller.rationale: Transient failures justify one re-attempt; second failure falls back to abort.

note: Consumers MUST compute cap as floor(ceiling.empirical_value * safety_margin). With the defaults above: floor(18 * 0.8) = 14. Dispatching more than 14 items in one Agent() call requires explicit justification per viv-orchestration-rules ADR-005.
